hero.subheadline: Driven by People, Powered by Choice.

footer.tagline: People-powered mobility and logistics — connecting riders, drivers, and communities across Africa and beyond.

about.heroP1: We are building more than a transportation platform. We are creating a people-powered technology ecosystem that connects individuals, businesses, and communities through mobility, logistics, and digital solutions.
about.heroP2: Our platforms are designed to make everyday services more accessible, affordable, and flexible while creating sustainable income opportunities for millions of people.
about.beliefLead: Every product we build is guided by one simple belief:
about.beliefHighlight: Technology should create opportunities, not barriers.
about.purposeBody: Serving people, empowering communities, and creating opportunities.

visionParts.text: To become the world's most trusted people-powered mobility, logistics, and technology ecosystem, connecting more than
to generate sustainable income across Africa and beyond.

about.missionBody: Our mission is to transform the way people move, work, and connect by delivering flexible transportation, logistics, and digital solutions that place decision-making power in the hands of service providers while offering customers exceptional value, safety, convenience, and choice.
commitments: Creating over 5 million jobs and income opportunities.
Serving more than 500 million users globally.
Building technology that enables economic inclusion.
Making transportation and logistics accessible, affordable, and reliable for everyone.

values.title: Customer First
values.body: Every decision begins with understanding and serving our customers.

values.title: Freedom & Flexibility
values.body: We believe work and mobility should adapt to people's lives, not the other way around.

values.title: Empowerment Through Choice
values.body: We put decision-making power into the hands of customers and service providers.

values.title: Economic Inclusion
values.body: We create pathways for individuals and businesses to earn, grow, and succeed regardless of their background or location.

values.title: Innovation Without Limits
values.body: We continuously innovate to provide smarter, faster, and more efficient solutions.

values.title: Trust & Transparency
values.body: We build trust through honesty, accountability, fairness, and open communication.

values.title: Community Impact
values.body: Our success is measured not only by profits but by the positive impact we create in communities.

values.title: Excellence in Execution
values.body: We strive for excellence in every ride, delivery, partnership, and customer interaction.

about.impactBody: We are building one of Africa's largest technology ecosystems. It empowers millions of entrepreneurs, drivers, businesses, and communities through innovative digital platforms.
about.promiseBody: We promise to build technology that is accessible, affordable, reliable, secure, inclusive, and community-driven. Because when people have access to opportunity, communities prosper.
about.communityMotto: Your Journey. Your Choice. Your Opportunity.
about.orgMotto: Driven by People, Powered by Choice.

drivers.heroHeadline: Drive on your terms, earn on your terms.
drivers.heroSub: Bring your moto, cab, hilux, or fuso. Download the Rides Driver app and start earning today.
drivers.heroNote: Read what we offer below before applying.
drivers.whyHeading: Built around the people doing the driving.
drivers.howHeading: Three steps. Most drivers are live within 48 hours.
drivers.eligibility: You will need a valid driver's licence, a working vehicle, a mobile money account, and government ID. The specifics for your vehicle are shared in-app during application.

benefits.title: Daily payouts
benefits.detail: Paid every working day, straight to your mobile money. No weekly batches, no minimum threshold.

benefits.title: Driver-first economics
benefits.detail: Transparent fares with no hidden cuts. You see what you'll earn before you accept the trip.

benefits.title: Real human support
benefits.detail: A live team in Kigali on call 24/7. When something goes wrong, someone actually answers.

benefits.title: Built in Rwanda
benefits.detail: Local team, local routes, local payment rails. We understand how Rwanda moves.

steps.title: Download the app
steps.detail: Get the Rides Driver app from the App Store or Google Play.

steps.title: Submit your details
steps.detail: The app walks you through it. Specific requirements for your vehicle appear during this step.

steps.title: Start earning
steps.detail: We review and approve you, usually within 24 to 48 hours. Then you're live.
